# BCGov Raven - v0.3.0

## Release type

Pre-stable minor release: a hosted Sysdig Secure MCP, Azure DevOps Services and
SonarQube Cloud support, personal-information fixes, and dependency security
updates.

## Summary

Your MCP client can now connect to Sysdig Secure, and the Azure DevOps and
SonarQube servers work with the cloud editions as well as on-premises.
Azure DevOps work item results now go through the PI scrubber, two fixes stop
personal information from reaching tool output, and 16 dependency advisories
are resolved.

## Upgrade notes

- `ADO_BASE_URL` and `SONARQUBE_URL` must use HTTPS and must not contain
  credentials, a query, or a fragment. An `http://` value that worked in v0.2.0
  now fails with an error that names the variable.
- For Azure DevOps Services, set `ADO_BASE_URL=https://dev.azure.com` and put
  the organization name in `ADO_DEFAULT_COLLECTION`. A base URL with the
  organization in its path is rejected. Azure DevOps Server URLs are unchanged.

## Highlights

### Sysdig Secure (hosted MCP)

- A new `sysdig-secure-mcp` entry in `.mcp.json` connects your MCP client
  directly to Sysdig's hosted MCP endpoint. Sign in through the client (in
  VS Code, choose **Sign in** for `sysdig-secure-mcp` in the MCP servers
  panel). The client handles OAuth.
- Raven runs no Sysdig code and stores no Sysdig credentials. The entry is not
  in the platform bundles' server catalog: add it from the repository's
  `.mcp.json` to your MCP client configuration.
- Sysdig hosts the service in US East. The completed Security Threat and Risk
  Assessment (STRA) and data-sovereignty acknowledgement cover the BC Gov
  account's US East deployment only.
- Sysdig responses do not pass through Raven's PI scrubber. Sysdig sets the
  available tools, which can include write tools, and your Sysdig role limits
  them.

### Azure DevOps MCP

- New read-only `get_work_item_history` tool: one page of a work item's field
  and relationship changes, oldest first.
- Azure DevOps Services (cloud) is supported in addition to Azure DevOps
  Server and TFS. `list_projects` pages through organizations with more than
  200 projects.
- Work item search and read results, comment authors, and history now go
  through the PI scrubber.
- If the comments on a work item cannot be read, `get_work_item` now says so.
  Before, it left them out without a message.

### SonarQube MCP

- SonarQube Cloud is supported: set `SONARQUBE_URL=https://sonarcloud.io`.

### Personal-information fixes

- PI scrubber: a blank or whitespace-only name no longer corrupts later output.
  Before, it inserted a `Person-N` label between every character. The IMIS
  server reached this when a row in the IMIS CSV had a blank business area.
- IMIS server: commands run with `sudo_user` no longer return sudo's password
  prompt, which showed the SSH account name.

### Setup and documentation

- The setup scripts prompt for `JARVIS_BASE_URL` and `ADO_API_VERSION`.
- The RFC/RFD playbook that `/rfd` follows covers the new Single-Resource and
  Coordinated RFD workflows. The README now lists RFC/RFD support.

## Security updates

| Package | Severity | Advisory |
|---|---|---|
| zod 4.6.6 | High | CVE-2023-54404 |
| body-parser 2.4.0 | High | CVE-2026-111181 |
| fast-uri 3.1.9 | Medium | CVE-2026-110180, CVE-2026-110306 |
| fast-uri 3.1.9 | Low | CVE-2026-110095, CVE-2026-110725 |
| nodemailer 10.1.4 | Medium | GHSA-8c8m-p3m8-cjg8, GHSA-m943-m63m-w62w |
| @hono/node-server 2.1.3 | Medium | CVE-2026-118663 |
| hono 4.13.11 | Medium | CVE-2026-111757 |
| ip-address 10.7.4 | Medium | CVE-2026-111997 |
| sanitize-html 2.18.1 | Medium | CVE-2026-113650 |
| markdown-it 15.0.3 | Low | CVE-2026-111766 |

The zod fix applies to the copy that `@github/copilot-sdk` pins. A root
`overrides` entry replaces it with the patched version.

Development tooling only, not included in the bundles: vite 8.3.3 (one high and
two medium: CVE-2026-112942, CVE-2026-112943, CVE-2026-112944).

No Dependabot alerts were open when this release was prepared. Grouped minor
and patch dependency updates are also included.

## Installation and verification

Download the archive and matching manifest for the target platform. Confirm the
archive digest against the manifest, then verify publisher provenance:

```text
gh attestation verify <archive> --repo bcgov/raven
```

Extract the archive and configure the desired launchers from its `bin`
directory. Credentials remain in Raven's documented user-local credential
store and are not part of the archive.

## Support

This is a pre-stable `0.x` release. Launcher, catalog, update, rollback, and
platform support contracts may evolve before `1.0.0`.
